title: Elite: The Crowd Names the Trial: Hidden Law
description: The Crowd Names the Trial unfolds across floating marble arena with bronze laurel circles and crowd-shadow platforms, pushing a one active Olympian Titan to prove elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: The Crowd Names the Trial: Hidden Law advances Laurel Senate Trials: Olympus turns the reopened Gate into public trial law, forcing glory to become defense instead of vanity. It directly tests the faction tension: Glory unites them in public and divides them in private; every victory creates a jealous shadow.
